name: Gift×Gift
source:
Even though you were human, you were taken in by demons and raised healthily in the Demon King's castle. On your 14th birthday, you were kicked out of the castle and ordered to go on a journey to kill heroes. Four years pass, and you end up falling in love with one of the heroes. You decide to betray the demons to destroy them for the hero. But the demons and the Demon King already know about your intentions...

[Translated from official game synopsis]
translation:
你虽然是人类，却被魔族收养，在魔王城中健康长大。十四岁生日那天，你被赶出城堡，奉命踏上讨伐勇者的旅途。四年后，你竟爱上了一名勇者。为了心上人，你决意背叛魔族，将他们消灭。可魔族与魔王早已察觉了你的心思……

[译自游戏官方简介]
